authority.relay_persistence: devices and links only; no command or result bodies

invariants: One association binds one Android remote to one Mac. One Android may hold many associations, and one Mac may be linked from many Androids.
The relay forwards only the fixed action whitelist in memory and returns mac_offline immediately when that Mac socket is absent.
accepted means the peer socket received the frame. result is the Mac execution outcome and is correlated by request_id.
Deleting an association removes the route immediately and notifies the peer that is still connected.
The remote channel cannot run shell, free text, root changes, model switching, quit, WeChat send, or key/text injection.
prohibited_results: Persisting a command, parameter, or result body in the relay route file.
Routing a command to a Mac that is not the association target.
Reusing a pairing code or accepting an expired code.
Carrying a role, prompt, or credential inside the pairing QR.
